parsed.notes:
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS sets required labels; PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS sets nice-to-have labels, including its unmapped techniques.
The explicit request for someone who wants to work by directing AI agents is treated as candidate appetite, rather than merely company description; flagged for review because the desire refers back to the preceding sentence.
Human-study methods, imaging methods, and simulation/modeling methods are read literally as technical practices and listed as unmapped where the taxonomy has no matching entry. Physiology specialties, sensing application areas, and startup experience are excluded as domain knowledge or experience context.
The modern ML stack is not expanded into unnamed libraries or tools. Imaging is not equated with computer vision.
Monte Carlo simulation, diffusion theory, and chromophore decomposition are listed together without an alternative marker, so no alternative group is assigned.
Substantial applied experience is not a seniority signal under the guide. No German requirement is stated.
